title: A Frogfish Strikes in 6 Milliseconds, Faster Than You Can React

scenes.text: This fish swallows its prey in six milliseconds.
You need more than two hundred milliseconds just to react.
It's a frogfish. It sits on the seafloor and wiggles a little lure on its head.
When prey gets close, its mouth swells to twelve times its resting volume and sucks the prey in.
Its stomach can stretch to hold prey twice its own size.
Six milliseconds. Gone before you could react.

description:
A frogfish can strike in about six milliseconds, far faster than a human can react.
Its mouth swells to up to twelve times its resting volume to suck the prey in.
Could you spot a frogfish on a reef?
